svg.title: Pixel Deck Foundations
svg.desc: Editable vector UI concept for the Stopwatch Overlay pixel deck theme.
svg.text: Night Deck is the default; Day Deck is a complete accessible counterpart.
Project tracking stays legible at a glance.
Familiar clock behavior in a game-like shell.
Gold fill; one dominant action per panel.
Never rely on color; pair dot with label.
Monospace all times, durations and chart values.
